1.original_instruction: With 2 or more people in your Party , the party leader needs speak with Dimensional Gorge Piece (gef_fild10 242, 202) to "Reserve the Orc's Memory".
1.short_ru: Лидер группы от 2 человек: Dimensional Gorge Piece, gef_fild10 242, 202 → «Reserve the Orc's Memory».
1.short_en: Party leader with at least 2 members: Dimensional Gorge Piece, gef_fild10 242, 202 → “Reserve the Orc's Memory”.
1.full_ru: В группе из 2 или более человек лидер должен поговорить с Dimensional Gorge Piece (gef_fild10 242, 202) и выбрать «Reserve the Orc's Memory».
1.full_en: With 2 or more people in your Party , the party leader needs speak with Dimensional Gorge Piece (gef_fild10 242, 202) to "Reserve the Orc's Memory".

locations.evidence: gef_fild10 242, 202

2.original_instruction: After the dungeon is created, speak to the Dimensional Gorge Piece to "Enter the Dungeon". Note: A window will appear showing pertinent time limits for the dungeon. If it is closed, it can be opened again with with the shortcut Alt+B. Note 2 : There is a 2 hour time limit for completing the quest before the instance is destroyed.
2.short_ru: Dimensional Gorge Piece → «Enter the Dungeon»; лимит — 2 часа, таймер — Alt+B.
2.short_en: Dimensional Gorge Piece → “Enter the Dungeon”; limit is 2 hours, timer is Alt+B.
2.full_ru: После создания подземелья поговорите с Dimensional Gorge Piece и выберите «Enter the Dungeon». Окно таймеров открывается через Alt+B. Примечание 2: на прохождение отведено 2 часа, затем инстанс уничтожается. Период повторного входа этого квеста/инстанса составляет два (2) часа.
2.full_en: After the dungeon is created, speak to the Dimensional Gorge Piece to "Enter the Dungeon". Note: A window will appear showing pertinent time limits for the dungeon. If it is closed, it can be opened again with with the shortcut Alt+B. Note 2 : There is a 2 hour time limit for completing the quest before the instance is destroyed. This quest or instance has a two (2) hour cooldown period.

source_additions.text_en: This quest or instance has a two (2) hour cooldown period.
source_additions.text_ru: Период повторного входа этого квеста/инстанса составляет два (2) часа.

3.original_instruction: Once inside, the party leader must speak to Kruger (1@orcs 180,29) to start the instance. Enchanted Orcs shown in blue
3.full_ru: Внутри лидер должен поговорить с Kruger (1@orcs 180,29), чтобы начать инстанс. На схеме Enchanted Orcs отмечены синим.
3.full_en: Once inside, the party leader must speak to Kruger (1@orcs 180,29) to start the instance. Enchanted Orcs shown in blue

4.original_instruction: To pass each zone on the first map, you must kill the Enchanted Orc in that zone (Enchanted Orcs are identical to Orc Warriors ). Kruger explains that each non-enchanted orc you kill will cause a High Orc to spawn near the exit. Depending on the challenge you wish to face, you may kill only the Enchanted Orc, or instead kill everything. If enough Orcs are killed, a large mob of Stalatic Golem will spawn at the end of the 4th zone.
4.short_ru: Убивайте Enchanted Orc в каждой зоне; лишние убийства вызывают High Orc и могут вызвать Stalatic Golem.
4.short_en: Kill Enchanted Orc in each zone; extra kills spawn High Orc and may trigger Stalatic Golem.
4.full_ru: Для прохода каждой зоны на первой карте нужно убить местного Enchanted Orc; внешне Enchanted Orcs совпадают с Orc Warriors. Kruger предупреждает: каждый убитый незачарованный орк вызывает High Orc у выхода. Можно убивать только Enchanted Orc либо всех противников ради сложности. Если орков убито достаточно, в конце 4-й зоны появится большая группа Stalatic Golem.
4.full_en: To pass each zone on the first map, you must kill the Enchanted Orc in that zone (Enchanted Orcs are identical to Orc Warriors ). Kruger explains that each non-enchanted orc you kill will cause a High Orc to spawn near the exit. Depending on the challenge you wish to face, you may kill only the Enchanted Orc, or instead kill everything. If enough Orcs are killed, a large mob of Stalatic Golem will spawn at the end of the 4th zone.

9.original_instruction: On the second map, speak to Kruger again (2@orcs 35, 169). He explains that you will need to extinguish the Braziers to proceed to the next zone. braziers in yellow, "bosses" in blue As before, depending on the challenge you wish to face, you may kill only the specific guards, or instead kill everything. If enough Orcs are killed, a large mob of Wraiths will spawn at the end of the 4th zone. Each Orc Zombie killed will respawn as an Orc Archer . Each Orc Skeleton killed will respawn as a High Orc .
9.short_ru: Поговорите с Kruger, 2@orcs 35, 169; активируйте Braziers и убивайте нужных охранников.
9.short_en: Talk to Kruger, 2@orcs 35, 169; activate Braziers and kill the required guards.

Можно убивать только нужных охранников либо всех противников. Если орков убито достаточно, в конце 4-й зоны появится большая группа Wraiths. Каждый убитый Orc Zombie возрождается как Orc Archer, а Orc Skeleton — как High Orc.

14.short_en: Defeat Shaman Cargalache; Anophles and Orc Hero remain on 2@orcs unless the described bug prevents cleanup.
14.full_ru: После смерти Shaman Cargalache все монстры на 2@orcs исчезают, кроме Anophles и Orc Hero. Одновременная смерть Shaman Cargalache и другого Orc может вызвать ошибку и помешать исчезновению монстров.
14.full_en: When Shaman Cargalache dies, all monsters on 2@orcs will de-spawn (except the Anophles and Orc Hero). Note : If Shaman Cargalache dies at the same moment as another Orc, a bug may prevent the de-spawn.
